title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theater on 1989-08-18
lineage: MAC > Sony TC-D5M (Dolby off) > Marantz CDR-500 > EAC > Soundforge (for fades) > CD-Wave > TLH (SBE-OK, FLAC compression, and checksums) > FLAC
source: Sennheiser MD-421's > patched thru one Sony D5 > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with no Dolby. Mics on six-foot stand in OTS

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording with standout Bird Song, Crazy Fingers in Space, and a gorgeous Stella Blue
ai_review.review: The tape offers a decent listening experience that captures several highlights—Bird Song, an inspired Crazy Fingers woven into Space, and a beautiful rendition of Stella Blue. While the recording isn’t pristine, it’s enough to enjoy the strong moments from what appears to be the band’s final show at the Greek Theatre.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; reviewer praises specific songs but notes only a 'decent' recording, leading to an estimated rating that balances good show moments with average audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a decent recording; no specific issues mentioned, suggesting acceptable clarity but not high‑fidelity soundboard quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments on overall flow; focus is on the highlighted moments rather than set structure.
